results.summary: This project is a Wokwi template that outputs a number to a seven-segment LED. Switching one of levers 1 through 8 causes the seven-segment LED to display the corresponding number, and the reset lever clears the display. If more than one lever is active at once, nothing happens. The design is a simple switch-to-seven-segment decoder.

results.summary_before: This design counts the number of digital pulses occurring within a time interval across four input channels. The counts are periodically output using a serial output. It is intended for low-power wake-up sensor interfaces, acoustic event detection, non-destructive testing, and particle counting. The design is a generic pulse-counting digital building block.
results.summary: This design is a variable duty-cycle true random number generator based on a ring voltage controlled oscillator concept. It contains seven 7-stage ring oscillators whose final NAND stages are enabled by an 'ena' signal, with outputs tied to a single node. That node passes through an inverter-bias system biased by a vDAC using the first four input pins to select a voltage. The biased signal then passes through two series D flip-flops and an enabled AND gate to produce the final random output bit.
